name: Sudan
value: Famine risk in Darfur; drone strikes in Kordofan
summary: IPC warns famine risk is rising in Darfur and Kordofan; a rights group says an air attack killed 13 in western Sudan
state: An IPC alert on 12 Oct said famine risk is rising in Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan, with child acute malnutrition above the Famine threshold in two East Jebel Marra camps (UN News). The army says it has retaken more than 30 villages and towns in North and West Kordofan since early Nov (Middle East Monitor, 13 Nov), and a rights group said on 16 Nov an army air attack killed 13 people in western Sudan (Al Jazeera). Famine risk spreading to new areas keeps the Alert.
for_you: Civilians in Darfur and Kordofan face drone strikes, displacement and hunger. FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan. Aid groups and Sudanese diaspora families are most exposed to disrupted supplies and communications.
rubric_hit: Famine spreading to new areas: IPC alert of 12 Oct finds malnutrition above the Famine threshold in East Jebel Marra camps (Alert)

why: The world's largest displacement and hunger crisis; regional spillover into Chad, South Sudan and the Red Sea.
drivers: SAF–RSF fighting, sieges, foreign arms supplies, aid access, famine.

rubric.alert: Major sieges or massacres reported, or famine spreading to new areas.
